title: Add VPC Flow Logs support (CloudWatch Logs or S3) + retention guidance
author: Victor Alvarez
body: Context: Private (VPC) installs need network auditability by default, and we’ve had repeated pilot questions on whether we support Flow Logs + where they can be shipped. This PR adds VPC Flow Logs support to `modules/vpc-baseline` with a destination switch (CloudWatch Logs or S3), and documents default retention guidance + security notes in the README. Summary of changes: Adds optional VPC Flow Logs with opinionated defaults (`enable_flow_logs=false` by default for alpha to avoid surprise log spend, but the module exposes a single toggle and sane defaults when enabled). Supports `flow_logs_destination = cloudwatch | s3` with validation. CloudWatch path: creates a log group, optional KMS key association (customer-managed key supported via `cloudwatch_log_group_kms_key_id`), and an IAM role/policy scoped to `logs:CreateLogStream`/`logs:PutLogEvents`. S3 path: config supports existing bucket (recommended) or creating a dedicated bucket with guardrails; supports SSE-KMS via optional key ARN; enforces bucket policy to allow `delivery.logs.amazonaws.com` with the expected ACL condition. Adds README guidance on retention: default recommendation 30 days for CloudWatch in alpha (customers can override), and for S3 we recommend lifecycle rules (module does not force lifecycle policies unless `create_s3_bucket=true` to avoid clobbering existing bucket governance). Outputs: exports flow log id, log group name/arn (CloudWatch), and/or bucket arn (S3) to enable installer preflights and customer reporting. Notes: We intentionally do not add NACL opinionation here (handled separately / doc-only) and we avoid enabling Flow Logs by default until the pilot confirms cost expectations. Example usage (CloudWatch): `enable_flow_logs = true, flow_logs_destination = "cloudwatch", cloudwatch_log_group_retention_in_days = 30`. Example usage (S3): `enable_flow_logs = true, flow_logs_destination = "s3", flow_logs_s3_bucket_arn = "arn:aws:s3:::my-central-logs-bucket"`. Testing: `terraform validate` on examples; added minimal unit-style assertions via variable validation; CI checkov exceptions updated for AWS log group KMS (only when explicitly set).

modules/vpc-baseline: add variable validations + outputs for flow logs
docs: README updates with retention and security guidance
ci: tune checkov rules for optional KMS paths (documented suppressions)

conversation: Allison Grant (review): Can we avoid creating a log group by default? Some customers have centralized log group governance. Also please add explicit retention guidance and call out that CW retention must be set to avoid infinite retention. Victor Alvarez (author): Agreed. I kept CloudWatch log group creation behind `flow_logs_destination == cloudwatch` and added `cloudwatch_log_group_name` override support so they can point to an existing group if they want. Also added README defaults + a note that retention should be set (we recommend 30 days for alpha) and is configurable. Kevin Osei (review): For S3, we need to be careful with bucket policy + encryption. If we create a bucket, it must block public access and default to SSE. If we’re consuming an existing bucket, do not attempt to manage lifecycle policies. Also: ensure the service principal is correct for flow log delivery and include the `bucket-owner-full-control` ACL condition. Victor Alvarez (author): Updated. When `create_flow_logs_s3_bucket=true`, we set block-public-access, enforce SSE-S3 by default with optional SSE-KMS, and add a tight bucket policy for `delivery.logs.amazonaws.com` with the ACL condition. For existing buckets, we only reference the ARN and don’t mutate lifecycle. Irene Choi (review): Variable naming: please align with our module standards (prefix with `flow_logs_` consistently) and add validation to prevent setting both `flow_logs_s3_bucket_arn` and `create_flow_logs_s3_bucket=true`. Also, call out cost trade-offs between CW and S3. Victor Alvarez (author): Done. Renamed vars to `flow_logs_*`, added mutual exclusion validation, and added a cost note (CWL ingestion + retention vs S3 storage + query tooling). Sahana Iyer (review): CI failed once on checkov complaining about missing KMS on CW log group and bucket encryption. If the module supports KMS but doesn’t require it, we should document the rationale and scope the suppression to the optional path only. Victor Alvarez (author): Updated `.checkov.yml` with targeted suppressions and README clarifying: encryption is enabled by default (SSE-S3 for buckets we create), and CW log group KMS is optional because many customers use org-managed keys and we accept an input for the key. Allison Grant (final): Approved. Please ensure outputs include log group ARN and flow log id for downstream dashboards/preflights. Victor Alvarez (author): Added outputs `flow_log_id`, `flow_logs_cloudwatch_log_group_arn`, and `flow_logs_s3_bucket_arn`. Irene Choi (final): Approved after last rename/validation pass.
release_notes: Terraform: `modules/vpc-baseline` now supports optional VPC Flow Logs with destination `cloudwatch` or `s3`, plus README guidance on retention and cost/security trade-offs.
